data.development: Identical AF-17 original 352 cases for eligibility only
data.new_logic: No; AF-17 Horn compositions are reused and only physical layouts are fresh.
data.source_features: Initial facts, rule incidence and host current proved set, with oracle cost/optimality exclusively as training targets.
data.split_receipt: fresh_manifest.json must regenerate exactly; heldout public-feature hashes disjoint from AF16, AF17 and AF18
data.train: Identical AF-17 original 928 cases and exact training-state sampling

evaluation.aggregation: Any eligible seed that fails a required gate causes registered aggregate FAIL. All four eligible seeds passing yields PASS. Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluation.eligibility: Each local/ancestor model at both loop counts must achieve >=0.65 success on provable goals separately on train and dev; all four must qualify to compare within seed.
evaluation.host_test: No neural proof claims. Model policy yields proposals; validated Horn transitions are the sole proof authority.
evaluation.independent_audit: Independent physical-incidence BFS for entire episode roster and sampled training costs, independent backward-ancestry graph traversal, explicit irrelevant perturbation, all exact source hashes and model/named-array equality, sampled checkpoint forward replay and causal-pair replays.
evaluation.mechanism_gate: For ancestor_l2, STOP-logit difference on at least two of three out-of-local-cone paired probes must exceed 0.0001; local_l2 should show <=1e-6 on the same pairs. Padded-rule STOP/distance/reach changes must each be <=1e-5 for every model/probe.
evaluation.proof_gate: Both ancestor models must beat their matched local same-loop model by >=0.05 absolute proof success on both heldout depths; ancestor arms must reach >=0.70 proof success and have <=0.02 extra premature STOP rate per family, zero falsely accepted proofs.
evaluation.secondary: L4 versus L2 within each readout, fixed/uniform/oracle baselines, paired reachability and distance signals, goal-irrelevant disconnected-fact diagnostic.

failure_policy: Preserve local and hosted engineering failures; scientific result may fail despite passed CI. Any revision of loss, masks, thresholds or heldout decisions requires a separately named registration.

formal.Lean: AncestorReadout.lean includes finite backward-mask monotonicity and direct-parent inclusion lemmas. Neural transport verified numerically; Lean module does not prove neural generalization.

mathematical_scope.ancestral_arm: Attend all rule states whose head lies in the transitive backward dependency closure of the goal.
mathematical_scope.backward_dependency: Starting at physical goal atom, iteratively include every rule whose head is active and each such rule premise until a least fixed point. Include only rules with nonzero public heads.
mathematical_scope.causal_claim: Global ancestry permits a distant fact to influence STOP through a remote rule state after fewer TypedLoop calls than required to reach the goal atom. It does not guarantee correct belief or sound unmasked rule choice.
mathematical_scope.invariance_scope: Exact invariance tests modify absent/padded-rule metadata and physically disconnected facts. The claim does not include arbitrary semantically irrelevant features on connected but cyclic neural message paths.
mathematical_scope.local_baseline: Attend only rule states whose head is the goal atom.
mathematical_scope.same_operator: Both arms run the same graph-mask closure computation, three 16x16 readout attention projections, masked softmax and weighted rule sum. Only the selected mask differs.

model.host_contract: Host alone computes current proved atoms, enabled legal-rule mask, exact shortest-cost labels and validated proof traces; learned model cannot add atoms directly.
model.shared_base: AF-17 BellmanTypedPolicy; goal, rule/STOP logits, reachability and distance heads retained

question: Can a goal-ancestry rule-state summary improve STOP/calibrated-distance decisions on fresh deep Horn layouts against a parameter-, per-loop and training-step-matched direct-goal-rule summary, while filtering truly disconnected graph changes?
title: Graph-ancestry STOP readout versus parameter-matched local Horn rule attention

training.checkpoint_policy: Fixed last update without restarts or heldout-driven model selection; save every model and named NumPy weight export, all failures/ineligible models and training loss trajectories.
training.fairness: Within each loop count, same native forward-call count, same readout tensor shapes/learned weights, same graph-mask computation and optimizer steps; ancestor/goal rule selection differs; measured runtime retained. L4 vs L2 is not compute matched.
training.identical_initialization: Per-seed each arm loads the exact same native cell/readout base/attention tensor state.
training.objective: AF-18 exact shortest-action CE plus 0.65 (STOP BCE +0.25 reach BCE) and 0.55 (legal-action Huber +0.5 remaining-distance Huber); identical across arms
training.runtime: Python 3.13 Torch 2.10 local CPU; pinned hosted Python 3.12 Torch 2.5.1 CPU where available
training.sampling: Exact AF-18 half legacy and half composed sampled states per update, identical per-seed generator sequence across arms.
